FN-5RZDM3-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 151
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/07/2023
Senate Bill 151 as introduced will increase the administrative obligations of the Department of
Commerce to publish on the Department's website certain information for each project receiving
Jobs Act incentives. This bill will not otherwise affect state of local funding.

FN-5RZDM3-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 151
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/14/2023
Senate Bill 151 as passed the Senate will increase the administrative obligations of the
Department of Commerce to publish on the Department's website certain information for each
project receiving Jobs Act incentives.
Additionally, this bill authorizes the Joint Legislative Advisory Committee on Economic
Incentives to request a third-party evaluation be conducted assessing the impacts of state
economic development incentives in an Executive Report which could increase the obligations
of: (1) the third-party to produce the report; and (2) the Department of Commerce, the
Department of Revenue and the Department of Labor, to provide requested data to the
third-party conducting the evaluation.

FN-5RZDM3-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 151
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/11/2023
Senate Bill 151 as reported by the Committee on Fiscal Responsibility and Economic
Development will increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Commerce to
publish on the Department's website certain information for each project receiving Jobs Act
incentives.
Additionally, this bill authorizes the Joint Legislative Advisory Committee to request a
third-party evaluation be conducted assessing the impacts of state economic development
incentives in an Executive Report which will increase the obligations of: (1) the Alabama
Commission on Higher Education to submit referrals, designate the third-party responsible for
the report, and determine the form and content for the report; and (2) the Department of
Commerce, the Department of Revenue and the Department of Labor, to provide requested data
to the third-party conducting the evaluation.

FN-5RZDM3-4
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 151
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/19/2023
Senate Bill 151 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education would increase
the administrative obligations of the Department of Commerce to publish on the Department's
website certain information for each project receiving Jobs Act incentives.
Additionally, this bill would authorize the Joint Legislative Advisory Committee on Economic
Incentives to request a third-party evaluation be conducted assessing the impacts of state
economic development incentives in an Executive Report which could increase the obligations
of: (1) the third-party to produce the report; and (2) the Department of Commerce, the
Department of Revenue and the Department of Labor, to provide requested data to the
third-party conducting the evaluation.
Finally, this bill would codify the current practice of the Secretary of the Senate and Clerk of the
House to provide clerical assistance to the committee.
